name: Higan de Warae
source:
...I had to die.

I had to, but I just kept putting it off.
Today, on the 31st of August, I've turned twenty five.
I've tried dying so many times and yet, I couldn't, so I've managed to live for this long.
I've gotten used to living a slow and pointless life, unable to die no matter how much time passes.

It's August 31st. It's been exactly ten years since that day.
I wonder if the perfect day to die is ever going to come.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7205]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
……我必须死去。

我不得不死，却一直拖延着。
今天是8月31日，我满25岁了。
我尝试过无数次去死，却始终没能成功，所以才活到了现在。
我已经习惯了缓慢而毫无意义的生活，无论时间过去多久，我都无法死去。

又是8月31日。距离那一天，正好过去了10年。
我不知道那个最适合死去的日子，究竟会不会到来。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7205]NovelGame[/url]]
